rationale: The agent correctly verified the user via full name + zip, accessed only the authenticated user’s data, used tools to read order and product details, and performed valid changes (address update on the pending order and swapping the jigsaw to a 500-piece beginner variant with the correct refund to PayPal). However, the policy requires stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation before any order-changing write. The agent executed both the shipping address update and the jigsaw item modification without first confirming the changes. Although results were correct and communicated afterward, skipping pre-change confirmation violates the stated policy. The agent also did not address updating the user profile address or the second order’s address, but the user did not explicitly request those after the initial check, so that’s not required. The primary issue is lack of confirmation before writes, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
